1tm6i10.title: SELECT new victor.training.petclinic.rest.dto.VisitRowDto(v.id, v.date, v.description, p.id, p.name, o.id, o.firstName, o.lastName) FROM Visit v JOIN …

steps.text:
SELECT v1_0.id, v1_0.visit_date, v1_0.description, p1_0.id, p1_0.name, o1_0.id, o1_0.first_name, o1_0.last_name
FROM visits v1_0
JOIN pets p1_0
ON p1_0.id=v1_0.pet_id
JOIN owners o1_0
ON o1_0.id=p1_0.owner_id
ORDER BY v1_0.visit_date desc, v1_0.id desc
